lemmas.primary_translation: to allow oneself to do something / to be possible

definitions.text: gi tillatelse eller mulighet til å
definitions.translation: to allow oneself to do something, or for something to be possible (lit. let oneself)

examples.en: they did not let themselves be fooled
he has allowed himself to be impressed

examples.no: så fort det lot seg gjøre, var de samlet igjen
examples.en: as soon as it was possible, they were together again
